_help: This file is the deal board. Add, edit or delete objects in the 'deals' list and the site updates on its own.
Required: id (unique, letters-numbers-dashes), hotel, city, country, region, perk.

region feeds the chips; all regions are always shown and ones with no open deal are greyed out. Use exactly: North America, Central America & Caribbean, South America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia, Australia & Pacific.
city feeds the city dropdown (only cities inside the chosen region are listed). destination is optional display text shown on the card instead of the city.
perks: what the guest gets (list). terms: the conditions (minimum nights, booking lead time, prepayment, blackout dates, travel window). They are shown as two separate blocks on the card.

Optional: bookBy and travelFrom/travelTo (YYYY-MM-DD), priceFrom (text), currency, priceNote, image (path or URL), art (beach | island | city | mountain | desert | jungle | coast, used when there is no image), note (one line), source (where the offer came from; not shown).

website: the hotel's official page. rating / ratingCount / ratingDate: the Google rating as looked up on ratingDate, shown next to the hotel name and linked to the hotel's Google page (reviews + placeId). Refresh these every month or two. With a Places API key in config.json the live rating replaces the stored one automatically.
Deals with a bookBy date in the past are hidden automatically, so you can leave them in the file until you tidy up.
Images: a path in assets/img/deals/ or a full https:// URL. The current URLs point at the hotels' own websites; swap them for files from the brand partner image libraries when you have time.
datesText (optional): replaces the automatic 'Book by… Travel…' line on the card, e.g. when an offer has no published end date. bookBy still controls when the card hides.
